answer: Overnight cold storage is what batch keys cannot fake. An applicant parks 8.40 POA in a tundra locker bound to a 28-byte cache-line (epoch seed XOR address) posted last evening. At dawn a 13-minute thaw begins: seven 7-byte pulses arrive 110 seconds apart, each signed from one 48-bit path fingerprint with jitter under 90 ms. A passing zephyr of peer probes then measures Hamming drift against the last 15 enrollments; distance below 9 flags a clone. Cost: 8.40 POA, overnight wait, seven live pulses. A missed pulse, reused line, or close drift burns 73% and seals the locker for eight epochs.
